name: m21_u3_coproc_malformed
source:
coproc apply_patch <<'PATCH'
not a patch
PATCH

name: m21_u3_coproc_descriptor
source:
coproc 2>public.out apply_patch <<'PATCH'
not a patch
PATCH

name: m21_u3_coproc_descriptor_pipeline
source:
coproc 2>public.out apply_patch <<'PATCH' | cat
not a patch
PATCH

name: m21_u3_coproc_fd3
source:
coproc 3<<'PATCH' apply_patch
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: public.txt
+synthetic
*** End Patch
PATCH

name: m21_u3_coproc_protected
source:
coproc apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: .env
*** End Patch
PATCH

name: m21_u3_coproc_inherited
source:
{ coproc { apply_patch; }; } <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: public.txt
+synthetic
*** End Patch
PATCH

name: m21_u3_argv_shadow
source:
apply_patch 'not a patch' <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: public.txt
+synthetic
*** End Patch
PATCH

name: m21_u3_env_argv
source:
env -Sapply_patch apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: public.txt
+synthetic
*** End Patch
PATCH

name: m21_u3_process_operand
source:
apply_patch <(cat public.patch) <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: public.txt
+synthetic
*** End Patch
PATCH
